messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Generation API (us-west-2) — elevated 5xx rate detected across gen-rt and streaming endpoints. Error spike started ~6187654300. Severity: P1. Auto-triage: backend model serving timeouts + queue saturation. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gen-5xx>
laura-oncall: Got it. I'm on call — investigating. @mike-sre can you take lead on runtime side? I'll coordinate comms.
mike-sre: Taking it. Looking at instance metrics now, seeing GPU mem pressure on pool-3 and a rise in queue length. Suspect recent rollout of fastgen-v2b config pushed higher token sizes.
anya-support: Heads up — we already have 3 customer tickets mentioning increased latency, one mentions client-side retries. I'll surface that in customer notes.
laura-oncall: Quick assessment: affected scope = hosted gen endpoints in us-west-2. Impact = elevated errors (~15% 5xx), increased latency for streaming. No SLA breach confirmed yet but trending. Drafting status post.
laura-oncall: Draft status page (initial) — please review quick:

```
We are investigating increased error rates and degraded streaming performance for the Generation API in the US West region. Customers may see 5xx errors or longer response times for streaming and completions. Our on-call team is actively investigating. We will provide an update within 15 minutes.
Affected services: Generation API (us-west-2)
Impact: Intermittent 5xx and elevated latency
Workaround: Retry logic and smaller max_tokens may reduce failures temporarily.
```

mike-sre: Content ok. Add that we have started a rollback window for the fastgen-v2b rollout (in progress) and a tentative ETA for next update in 15m.
laura-oncall: Updated draft snippet with rollback note.

```
Update: We have initiated a rollback of the recent fastgen-v2b rollout in US West to stabilize serving. Next update in ~15 minutes or sooner.
```
laura-oncall: @tom-pm any customer-facing phrasing concerns? @legal any compliance wording to include?
tom-pm: wording good. Suggest replacing "smaller max_tokens" with "reducing max_tokens" to avoid implying product change. Also add: "We will follow up with a full incident report once resolved."
legal: No legal blockers. Avoid naming specific customers in public copy.
anya-support: I'll prep customer DM template based on the draft — short note acknowledging we're investigating and linking status page.
mike-sre: Ops update: rollback rolling out to 6 host groups, currently 2/6 complete. Error rate down ~40% on those groups.
laura-oncall: Nice. I'll publish the initial statuspage now with the rollback note and ETA for next update.
laura-oncall: Published initial status update :white_check_mark:

mike-sre: Monitoring. Queue length continuing to drop as more hosts rollback. Will post another update when 4/6 done.
anya-support: Sent customer DMs to impacted orgs with status link and short blurb. Keeping support thread open.

mike-sre: 4/6 groups rolled back — error rate now down to baseline for those. Overall error rate dropped from 15% -> ~6%.
laura-oncall: Drafting follow-up status update (partial recovery):

```
We are seeing partial recovery after initiating a rollback of the recent fastgen-v2b rollout in US West. Error rates are decreasing as rollback completes; some customers may still experience transient failures. We will continue to monitor and post a resolution notice when all hosts are healthy.
Next update in 10 minutes or when fully resolved.
```

laura-oncall: Posting partial-recovery update now.
laura-oncall: :thumbsup: Posted.
mike-sre: Rollback complete (6/6). Metrics look stable across the pool. Running post-rollback validation jobs (synthetic traffic) — no errors at 1k RPS for 10m.
laura-oncall: Great. Drafting resolved notice:

```
Resolved: The Generation API in US West has returned to normal operation after we rolled back a recent configuration rollout (fastgen-v2b). Error rates and latency have normalized. We are conducting a follow-up investigation to determine root cause and will publish a post-incident report.
If you continue to experience issues, please contact support or reply to this status update.
```

mike-sre: Recommend adding the timeframe: started ~6187654300, resolved ~6187654390.
laura-oncall: Added timestamps and published resolved notice :white_check_mark:
anya-support: Closing customer tickets with summary and link to status. Will escalate individual ongoing issues.
tom-pm: Thanks all. Please add a short TL;DR to the post-incident report about config knob that increased memory footprint and how rollout gating will change.
laura-oncall: Agreed — adding to action items. Closing thread after I start the incident report draft.
incident-bot: Incident closed by laura-oncall. Final severity: P1 -> mitigated. Metrics attached to incident archive."
